ev.q: In 2020, 25.3% of adults aged ≥18 years met the 2018 federal physical activity guidelines for both muscle-strengthening and aerobic physical activity
The percentage meeting both guidelines was highest in adults living in large central metropolitan (28.0%)
Age-adjusted percentages are based on the 2000 U.S. Census Bureau standard population
